en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Moamar Bin Khallad who said,

‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who eats food in his house, so something from it falls off, so let him take it; and the one who eats in the desert, or outside, so let him leave it for the birds and the wild animals’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Mu’ammar ibn Khallad who has said the following: “

I once heard abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘If one eats food in his house and pieces of food fall off, he must pick them up and eat; but if one eats food in the wilderness or outdoors he should leave such pieces for the birds and beasts.”’ (See also Ch. 48, h 15)
